newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokian Renkaat sees EPS improving in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Nokian Renkaat sees EPS improving in 1996.

text.p: Finnish tyre manufacturer Nokian Renkaat Oy said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1996 earnings per share to improve on last year's 6.93 markka.
"We expect 1996 earnings per share to improve on last year," Nokian Renkaat said in a statement.
The situation on the tyres market was still unstable, but was expected to improve gradually towards the end of 1997, the company said.
Nokian Renkaat's January-August report showed a 52 million markka profit before extraordinary items and taxes, up from 41 million in the first eight months in 1995.
Nokian Renkaat's eight-month earnings per share rose to 3.38 markka from 3.11 markka.
Group net sales rose to 652 million markka from 630 million.
